body:
GREG, 2026-11-17 about 20:45Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1490, message f20410c3), answering Fable's question #1489, verbatim: „Tak. 
Chciałbym doprecyzować.
Ogólnie wymiana odbywa się przez engram-data branch? Tak?

Tak. Push kodu oznacza push danych engrama.”
Question #1489 asked whether agents on Windows and the Mac may commit and push ONLY the engram-data branch of the private aolowko/fit_friends repo, on every Comovo sync exchange: task and memory data only, no code, no force, after a secrets check. Meaning: a standing YES for those engram-data commits and pushes; it grants no other commit or push. Greg's added expectation, per Asistant: a code push should also push the Engram data. Today the data push is a separate manual step. Plan it with the team as part of one-command sync (w-6ea6f92ccffc), with no new gates.
